messages:
nina: Heads-up: Support escalated a POC activation fail for acct solargrid-7. Ingest errors blocking onboarding demo in 24h.

liam (support): Error from customer agent when writing to S3: 403 AccessDenied. Retries 3x. Ticket SUP-8021.

liam: ```
2025-05-14T11:18:02Z ERROR ingest: PUT https://s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/solargrid-ingest/object 403 AccessDenied
CausedBy: AssumeRoleDenied: sts:AssumeRole denied for role arn:aws:iam::999999:role/redwood-ingest-role
```

mike: Likely missing role consent on their side. Fast mitigations: (A) enable managed ingest proxy (us-east-1) temporarily, (B) run a 20-min IAM consent walkthrough during demo, (C) provide IaC snippet they can apply. Proxy requires infra approval.

infra-bot: Created ticket PROXY-214; approval required. ETA ~30m.

sophie: Comms draft (short):
"We're sorry for the interruption. We can enable a short-lived managed ingest proxy so your demo can proceed. Alternatively, we can walk your infra team through granting the role now (20 min). Which do you prefer?"

nina: Risk: renewal checkpoint in 18 days and demo with partner tomorrow. Recommend proxy + offer 1-hr enablement after demo and a goodwill 2-week POC extension if issue not resolved. Need CS sign-off for extension.

mike: Infra approved proxy. Enabling now; ETA 10m. Data transit uses TLS, objects stored in customer-specific bucket with 7d TTL unless customer requests change. Docs: https://redwood.internal/security/data-proxy.

liam: Customer accepted proxy and booked IAM walkthrough at 09:30 CET tomorrow. I sent calendar invite.

cs-bot: Marked account solargrid-7 as renewal-risk-high; added to cs-tracker.

sophie: Sending comms now with clear opt-in and privacy FAQ. I'll attach the enablement checklist slide.

nina: Post-demo notes: ingest completed, partner demo went ahead. Customer requested RCA and to keep POC extension as backup. I'll draft RCA and propose extension. Closing escalation for now.
